practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Training the heart away from comparison
practice.issueStatement: Comparison rarely disappears through one good insight. It returns through habit: the glance, the measure, the inner subtraction, the quiet refusal to receive your own portion.
practice.centralInsight: Gurbani weakens comparison by retraining attention. The heart becomes freer when it practices gratitude for hukam instead of rehearsing someone else's arrangement.
practice.practicalReflection: A life of comparison is built in repetitions. A freer life must also be built in repetitions: blessing, truthful work, and refusal to keep auditing your worth against another person's scene.
practice.actionPrompt: For one week, interrupt the first comparison of the day by naming your own assignment before you name anyone else's advantage.
